script.text: Wait. There are so many unanswered questions. Like how you ever ended up in the Shadow Realm? Titan said you did it for the power.
Believe me, Lexie. I never chose to go. One day, a few of us were told to meet at the abandoned dorm. And then...it happened.
There was supposed to be a duel test in the basement. But instead, we found hundreds of those little shadow fiends. I couldn’t escape.
I was brought to the Shadow Realm. They brainwashed me for months until I became this thing called Nightshroud.
By who?! Who was it that brainwashed you?
I never did figure that out. However, the person who called me to take the duel test was....Professor Banner.
Our Professor Banner?! So he’s in on it?!
